description: Pulls the weekly Shanghai Containerized Freight Index, persists snapshots locally, and renders lane-filtered digests for ocean-freight forwarders.

novel_features.name: Lane-filtered digest
novel_features.description: Render the latest weekly snapshot as JSON or Markdown; optional --lane <fragment> repeatable filter narrows to the lanes the user cares about. No defaults — works for any forwarder regardless of lane portfolio.

novel_features.name: Comprehensive-index contribution
novel_features.description: Decomposes the headline SCFI move into per-lane contributions by multiplying each lane's weighting percent by its percent change.

novel_features.name: Lane-vs-comprehensive divergence
novel_features.description: Per-week spread between a lane's percent change and the comprehensive index over the last N weeks, with cumulative drift.

novel_features.name: Compare with in-house rate sheet (stub)
novel_features.description: Joins the user's quote workbook (xlsx) against the latest SCFI per lane and tags every row High/Low/Par with the USD/TEU gap. v0.1 ships a stub; full implementation lands when the rate-store reader does.

novel_features.name: Null-lane gap report
novel_features.description: Lists weeks where SSE returned null for one or more lanes — a service quirk that breaks naive scripts.

novel_features.name: Lane volatility ranking
novel_features.description: Per-lane standard deviation / mean / min / max of weekly percent change over the last N weeks; ranks the most volatile lanes first.

novel_features.name: Unit normalization
novel_features.description: Converts every lane to a single unit (USD/TEU or USD/FEU) so cross-lane comparisons aren't apples-to-oranges.
